header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH, CIRCUIT COURT, MIRPURKHAS
(Muhammad Yousuf v/s. Province of Sindh & Ors)
Petitioner: Through Mr. Sandeep Kumar Maheshwari, Advocate
body: 1. Through instant Petition, the Petitioner has claimed appointment against deceased quota available under Rule 11 - A of the Sindh Civil Servants (Appointment, Promotion & Transfer) Rule, 1974 (APT Rules).

2. It is the case of the Petitioner that his father was employed in Government Service and died while in service. Petitioner approached the Respondents to consider his case for appointment but to no avail.

3. Learned Additional Advocate General, states that Government of Sindh has constituted a committee to consider the cases of children of deceased employees in terms of Rule 11-A of APT Rules. It is sated that case of the petitioner may be referred to the Committee and the same shall be decided in accordance with law.

4. In view of above, this petition is disposed of. The Respondents are directed to place the case of Petitioner before the departmental scrutiny committee and decide the same within a period of 3 months’ time from date of this order.
[2] Criminal Bail Applications No.S-288 of 2026 5. Office is directed to send copy of this Order to the Respondents for compliance.
